content.text:
I can't give you this number, because Chicago doesn't publish it. Chicago's open-data permit dataset (data.cityofchicago.org, dataset ydr8-5enu) only includes permits that have already been issued. It has no records of applications that are still in plan review or waiting to be issued. The data was last updated 2026-11-24, but that doesn't change what it covers. A count of zero from it would be misleading, so I didn't run one.

Of the cities this tool covers, only Seattle publishes applications and plan-review statuses. In Chicago, you'd need to ask the Department of Buildings directly.

FINAL ANSWER: UNAVAILABLE
